<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  vtk的了解学习途径跟随代码中的示例，循序渐进。<br>  本篇详细解析Cone.exe，后在Qt中复现一样的。</p>

<h2><a id="_21"></a>示例代码深度解析</h2>

</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp"><span class="token keyword">int <span class="token function">main<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)
<span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token comment">// 步骤一：创建圆锥体数据源
    vtkConeSource <span class="token operator">*cone <span class="token operator">= vtkConeSource<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">New<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    cone<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetHeight<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">3.0 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    cone<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetRadius<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">1.0 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
cone<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetResolution<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">10 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token comment">// 步骤二：创建多边形数据映射器（注意：可以在数据源和映射器之间插入中间过滤器）
    vtkPolyDataMapper <span class="token operator">*coneMapper <span class="token operator">= vtkPolyDataMapper<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">New<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
coneMapper<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetInputConnection<span class="token punctuation">(cone<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">GetOutputPort<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">) <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token comment">// 步骤三：创建一个演员来代表圆锥体。演员协调映射器图形图元的渲染。actor还通过vtkProperty实例引用属性，并包含一个内部转换矩阵。我们将此actor的映射器设置为上面创建的coneMapper。 
    vtkActor <span class="token operator">*coneActor <span class="token operator">= vtkActor<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">New<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
coneActor<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetMapper<span class="token punctuation">( coneMapper <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token comment">// 步骤四：创建渲染器并为其分配演员。渲染器就像一个视口。它是屏幕上窗口的一部分或全部，负责绘制它所拥有的演员。我们还在此处设置了背景颜色。  
vtkRenderer <span class="token operator">*ren1<span class="token operator">= vtkRenderer<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">New<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
ren1<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">AddActor<span class="token punctuation">( coneActor <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
ren1<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetBackground<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">0.1<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">0.2<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">0.4 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

<span class="token comment">// 步骤五：创建渲染窗口，它将显示在屏幕上。使用AddRenderer将渲染器放入渲染窗口。将渲染器大小设置为300像素乘300像素。  
vtkRenderWindow <span class="token operator">*renWin <span class="token operator">= vtkRenderWindow<span class="token operator">::<span class="token function">New<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  renWin<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">AddRenderer<span class="token punctuation">( ren1 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
  renWin<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">SetSize<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">300<span class="token punctuation">, <span class="token number">300 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token comment">// 步骤六：现在我们循环360度，每次渲染圆锥体。
    <span class="token keyword">int i<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token keyword">for <span class="token punctuation">(i <span class="token operator">= <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">; i <span class="token operator">&lt; <span class="token number">360<span class="token punctuation">; <span class="token operator">++i<span class="token punctuation">)
    <span class="token punctuation">{
        <span class="token comment">// render the image
        renWin<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Render<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
        <span class="token comment">// rotate the active camera by one degree
        ren1<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">GetActiveCamera<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Azimuth<span class="token punctuation">( <span class="token number">1 <span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    <span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token comment">// 释放对象
    cone<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Delete<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    coneMapper<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Delete<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    coneActor<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Delete<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    ren1<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Delete<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;
    renWin<span class="token operator">-&gt;<span class="token function">Delete<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;

    <span class="token keyword">return <span class="token number">0<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="Demo_70"></a>复现Demo</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  有一个很重要的点，这个示例代码是阻塞时的循环刷新，与Qt的基于消息的编程处理方式不一样，这是过程式的编程，我们复刻示例，保持一块Demo就一个函数，否则的话，可以使用Qt定时器来实现更新位置就可以了。</p>
</div>
